content.value_statement: Data assets often lack active markets, making valuation methods and assumptions difficult to defend. This skill structures evidence-based valuations under Chinese appraisal guidance.
actual_capabilities: Identifies valuation purposes, asset boundaries, value types, and valuation dates.
Selects income, cost, and market approaches using a documented decision process.
Structures assumptions for attributable income, useful life, discount rates, replacement cost, and adjustment factors.
Compares results from multiple approaches and explains material differences.
Drafts valuation report sections, evidence lists, review checklists, and stakeholder responses.
Flags ownership, compliance, qualification, market, and parameter risks before conclusions.
limitations: It does not replace a licensed appraisal institution or authorized appraiser.
It cannot verify source records, legal ownership, market transactions, or management forecasts independently.
Illustrative parameter ranges require current evidence and professional judgment before use.
Its guidance focuses on Chinese data asset appraisal practices and may not fit other jurisdictions.

use_cases.title: Prepare an accounting valuation
use_cases.description: Define the asset boundary, select methods, request evidence, and prepare a review-ready valuation analysis.

use_cases.title: Assess collateral support
use_cases.description: Explain valuation assumptions, financing discounts, report validity, and evidence needed for lender review.

use_cases.title: Review appraisal workpapers
use_cases.description: Check parameter support, method selection, cross-validation, disclosures, and required signatures before report issuance.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a valuation method
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this data asset: [description]. Ask for missing facts, then recommend suitable valuation methods and explain the selection.

prompt_templates.title: Build an evidence request
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a document request for valuing [asset] for [purpose] on [date]. Cover ownership, costs, income, quality, markets, and compliance.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze valuation parameters
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these assumptions: [assumptions]. Test income attribution, useful life, discount rate, replacement cost, adjustment factors, and comparable transactions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a cross-validated conclusion
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these valuation results: [results]. Reconcile differences, perform sensitivity analysis, state limitations, and draft a defensible conclusion for [audience].

output_examples.input: A retailer wants to value customer behavior data for accounting recognition but has no direct data sales.
output_examples.output: Recommended approach: use the cost method as the primary method and test attributable efficiency gains through the income method. Verify ownership and compliance first.

output_examples.input: A lender asks why financing is lower than the appraised value.
output_examples.output: The appraisal estimates asset value under stated assumptions. Credit limits may apply discounts for liquidity, enforceability, value volatility, and disposal uncertainty.

output_examples.input: Review a valuation using a five-year income period and a high data contribution rate.
output_examples.output: Request evidence for data refresh cycles, customer retention, income attribution, and the contribution benchmark. Test shorter periods and lower contribution rates.

best_practices: Define the valuation purpose, asset boundary, value type, and date before selecting a method.
Document every material assumption with traceable evidence and run sensitivity tests for uncertain parameters.
Use at least two approaches when feasible and explain differences before forming a conclusion.
anti_patterns: Do not target a desired value or adjust unsupported parameters to meet financing expectations.
Do not treat replacement cost as value without evaluating quality, utility, market demand, and legal constraints.
Do not present an AI-generated analysis as a signed appraisal report from a licensed institution.

faq.question: Which valuation methods does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports income, cost, and market approaches, including method selection and cross-validation.

faq.question: Can it produce an official appraisal report?
faq.answer: It can draft report content, but a qualified institution and authorized appraisers must issue any official report.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the valuation purpose, asset scope, date, ownership evidence, costs, income forecasts, quality records, contracts, and comparable transactions.

faq.question: Can data without direct revenue be valued?
faq.answer: Yes. The cost approach may be suitable, while measurable cost savings or efficiency gains may support an income analysis.

faq.question: Why can financing be lower than appraised value?
faq.answer: Lenders may discount for limited liquidity, uncertain disposal, regulatory risk, enforceability, and value volatility.

faq.question: Does it work outside China?
faq.answer: The analytical methods are broadly useful, but regulatory references and reporting requirements require local professional review.
